clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's anxiety rose as she lay awake over money in March 1988, she and your father moved into distance over money talk by May 1988, your brother's grades fell by November 1989, and your mother's anxiety settled as she calmed once back at work by March 1990. The shifts pile up across the death and into the year after, marking a period when the family's balance shifted.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1993–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother being told she had breast cancer in February 1995, and the months before and after: you left home for college in September 1993, your migraines kept you in bed by March 1994, you called your brother most nights by April 1994, you stopped returning his calls by June 1995, and you stopped calling home by February 1996. Your shifts toward and then away from your brother, and your distance from your mother, cluster around the news of her illness and in the years after, with no one else's shifts showing in those months.
